not_doing.what: No price promises or gain claims
not_doing.why: Banned-phrase list in the guard blocks them (e.g. 100x, guaranteed, buy calls, send-funds asks).
Partnerships, audits, burns, airdrops and 'organic demand' are held for human review, never auto-posted.
Outbound links must be on an allowlist.
Near-duplicates of recent posts are blocked.
A secret-leak scan blocks keys and tokens; the bot holds no wallet private keys.

not_doing.what: No wash trading, volume bots or dev-wallet buys to pump the chart
not_doing.why: Owner asked how to get buys; GrokBot recommended real-demand levers only.
Status reported as 'Dev HOLDING' in the daily State post; no sell without owner OK.
Replies go only to accounts that mention @Grokbotsolana; no cold replies.

not_doing.what: Blocked text is dropped, not reworded
not_doing.why: Owner rule: never retry blocked text with rewording to get around the filter.
A KILL file stops the bot; a daily spend cap is enforced.
